_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Aerospace Systems (segment hyper-croissance post-Meggitt) en hero, puis Diversified Industrial (core ~69% CA), marges et backlog Aerospace en fin (signaux operationnels).

kpis.signal: Segment transformateur post-Meggitt (2022), hypercroissance +159% sur 5 ans, mix aftermarket commercial + defense favorable
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Aerospace Systems : airframe, engine components, fuel/inerting, flight control. Boost massif via acquisition Meggitt (FY23). ~31% CA Parker FY25, transforme profil croissance et marges du groupe.
kpis.description_en: Aerospace Systems segment revenue: airframe, engine components, fuel/inerting, flight control. Massive boost from Meggitt acquisition (FY23). ~31% of Parker FY25 revenue, transforms group growth and margin profile.

kpis.signal: Core historique Parker, ~69% CA FY25, recul cyclique en 2025 (divestitures CFC + demande off-highway/transport faible)
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Diversified Industrial : motion-control, fluid & gas, filtration, sealing. North America + International. Pilier historique Parker, cyclique avec marche industriels (off-highway, transport, energy, HVAC).
kpis.description_en: Diversified Industrial segment revenue: motion-control, fluid & gas, filtration, sealing. North America + International. Parker historical pillar, cyclical with industrial markets (off-highway, transport, energy, HVAC).

kpis.signal: Expansion massive marge Aero post-integration Meggitt, mix aftermarket commercial favorable, +10 pts vs FY23
kpis.description_fr: Marge operationnelle segment Aerospace. Dip FY23 lie aux charges integration Meggitt, puis remontee spectaculaire grace au mix aftermarket commercial et cost containment. Demontre execution Win Strategy.
kpis.description_en: Aerospace Systems segment operating margin. FY23 dip due to Meggitt integration charges, then dramatic recovery driven by commercial aftermarket mix and cost containment. Demonstrates Win Strategy execution.
kpis._specific_to: Parker Win Strategy Aerospace margin expansion

kpis.signal: Backlog Aero +126% sur 5 ans, orders > shipments OEM commercial & defense, visibilite revenue Aerospace forte
kpis.description_fr: Carnet de commandes ferme segment Aerospace Systems. Indicateur de visibilite CA futur. Croissance soutenue refletant la demande aeronautique post-COVID + integration Meggitt + cycle defense.
kpis.description_en: Firm order backlog for Aerospace Systems segment. Forward revenue visibility indicator. Sustained growth reflecting post-COVID aerospace demand + Meggitt integration + defense cycle.

kpis.signal: Expansion continue marge DI grace Win Strategy : pricing, mix produits, cost containment, restructurations
kpis.description_fr: Marge operationnelle segment Diversified Industrial. Progression continue +4 pts sur 5 ans via Win Strategy 3.0 (pricing discipline, mix premium, simplification, restructurations cibles). Resilience malgre baisse de volumes FY25.
kpis.description_en: Diversified Industrial segment operating margin. Continuous +4 pts expansion over 5 years via Win Strategy 3.0 (pricing discipline, premium mix, simplification, targeted restructuring). Resilience despite FY25 volume decline.
